title: Professional Client Classification for High Leverage (>1:30)
precondition: Client applies for 1:500 leverage under professional status.
steps: 1. Verify MiFID II elective professional criteria.
expected: Requires verified portfolio size > €500k and trading activity; non-qualified clients locked to 1:30.
coverage_note: Requires compliance policy fixtures, jurisdiction controls, document/audit access and authorized evidence. Trading API success cannot establish compliance.
